newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IBP Inc hold repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IBP Inc hold repeated.

text.p: Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Friday she reiterated a hold rating on meat processor IBP Inc, which she said is entering hog production.

-- "IBP Inc announced that it is entering hog production -- initially with production contracts, but possibly with its own production," Wittenburg said in a report. "The motivation is to keep its processing plants as efficiently utilized as possible."
-- The analyst's report repeated comments she made Thursday. IBP officials were not available Thursday or Friday.
-- "IBP tends not to undertake anything unless it can do so big time and do it well, so we find this move intriguing strategically," Wittenburg said.

-- Wittenburg also said that Smithfield Foods Inc Chairman Joe Luter, also speaking at the conference, said the fresh pork industry would not be profitable in 1997, 1998 or 1999 unless a major player or players reduce a significant amount of processing capacity.
-- "However, Luter noted that his company is making substantial money in pork production, including premium pricing on their NPD pigs, and said processing has been good," Wittenburg said.
-- Earlier, Wittenburg downgraded Smithfield, primarily on price.
